sop_thesis: **Under Armour (UA)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Apparel) with an established market capitalization of $1.80B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $5.6 (17.9% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $4.66 (Tranche 1), $4.37 (Tranche 2), and $4.04 (Tranche 3).
